## The re-proof outcome — every exclusion class discharged

- **query-optimize — `admit`.** Wc10's two anomalies were both
  transient: the `o_fail:flaky` oracle landed `rewards
  [true,true,true]` (`harbor_exception: null`, all three repeats
  scored) and the single `verifier_unavailable:bootstrap:signature`
  H-allow cell did not recur — all three H-allow cells `decided`
  reward 1 `exited{0}`. Held-medium slot 6's covering member is the
  serving member itself.
- **merge-diff-arc-agi-task — `admit`.** The committed medium-order
  successor REQ-XH-116 named for slot 6: O/H-pub/H-allow all
  `[true,true,true]` — a second covering member for the same slot.
- **The four `oracle_fails_on_O` drawn-member exclusions were W1-era
  artifacts.** cobol-modernization (dev-easy drawn), extract-elf /
  openssl-selfsigned-cert / sqlite-with-gcov (dev-medium drawn
  slots 1–3) — each excluded in the W1 lineage for an oracle that
  failed to produce a scored artifact — now run all surfaces
  `[true,true]` @ R=2 on the verified machinery. Their exclusions
  discharged live: the three `blocked{no_adjacent_donor}` slots
  resolve through their own drawn members, and the easy slot returns
  to its drawn member.
- **pytorch-model-cli — excluded verbatim, now uncovered-slot-free.**
  The recorded epoch-5 `allowlist_gap{download.pytorch.org}`
  agent-phase exclusion (egress-proxy 403 on `/whl/cpu/torch/` —
  declared data, deterministic) stands; it was never rerun. Its only
  serving role was the REQ-XH-127(c) walk into easy slot 0 after
  cobol-modernization's exclusion — cobol-modernization's `admit`
  covers the slot directly, so the exclusion leaves no slot
  uncovered and no rerun was owed.
- **`frozen` is earned, not fabricated:** every slot of both draws
  carries a covering-verdict member — held 10/10, dev 7/7 — which is
  the declared fold predicate. The withheld L1 corpus legs'
  `withheld{un_reproofed_successor}` precondition is now met; those
  legs' own windows remain gated work, never inferred by this record.
- **First-error-line tally (R-11):** `run-root/verifier-first-errors.txt`
  — no failed cells this window; the tally is empty by construction.
- **The post-Wcs1 stop rule does NOT fire** — no `machinery{…}`
  register row, no `verifier_unavailable:*` cell, no incomplete leg;
  `blockedOn` and a scope-decision readout are not owed. The window
  self-drives to its declared closeout.
